risks.title: Tariffs and trade tensions
risks.score_rationale: Company is directly exposed to U.S. tariffs imposed since Q2 2025, with Chinese retaliatory measures. Material impact on FY2025 results partially mitigated by mitigation strategy (global sourcing, pricing, cost reduction). Dedicated MD&A and mention in forward-looking risk statements.

risks.title: Foreign exchange rate fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: Company operates globally (40,000 clients in 100+ countries). Short-term hedging program (12 months) on revenues/costs/balance sheet. Structural long-term exposure. Detailed MD&A on Currency Exchange Rate Exposure.

risks.title: Macroeconomic conditions and customer demand
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements enumerate: inflation, potential recession, financial market volatility, reduced credit access, interest rate changes. Customer sectors sensitive to economic cycles (aerospace, defense, automotive, electronics). Customer R&D demand depends on macroeconomic conditions.

risks.title: Acquisition and integration risks
risks.score_rationale: Three acquisitions in FY2025: Spirent ($1,415M, $9M additional revenue), Synopsys OSG ($578M), Ansys PowerArtist ($26M). High acquisition and integration costs in 2025, cited as net income reduction factor. Real integration risk but acquisitions are strategic.

risks.title: Competition and pricing pressure
risks.score_rationale: Test and design market is highly competitive. Gross margin declining (62.1% vs 62.9% prior year), partly due to tariff impact but also product/service mix. Implicit pricing pressure in competitive environment. 8% revenue growth but margin at 5-year lows.

risks.title: Regulatory compliance and export controls
risks.score_rationale: Forward-looking statements mention 'tightening of export control regulations'. Company operates in regulated sectors (defense, aerospace, government, telecommunications). Risk of market access restrictions or sensitive customer limitations.

ai_positioning.summary: Keysight does not directly commercialize AI products but positions its test and design solutions as enablers for customers investing in AI. The company notes that customers are expected to continue R&D investments in AI and related technologies, including AI, industrial IoT, 5G/6G, and autonomous vehicles.
evidence: Outlook section: 'Our customers are expected to continue to make R&D investments in certain next-generation technologies and applications, including evolution of 5G, early 6G, high-speed data center networks and infrastructure, satellite networks, artificial intelligence (AI), industrial internet of things (IoT), defense modernization, and next generation electric vehicles and autonomous vehicles.'
